name: omc-watchdog
description: Shows a band above the prompt when an oh-my-claudecode run in this session is dead or looping: ralph, autopilot, team or ultragoal marked active but not touched for hours, or reinforced past a limit or at its iteration cap. Names the mode and phase. Read only; hidden when all is well.

staleHours.title: Stale after (hours)
staleHours.description: An active mode whose state has not been touched for longer than this is shown as stale. OMC itself treats state older than 2 hours as stale. A value of 0 or less uses 2.

reinforcementLimit.title: Looping at reinforcement count
reinforcementLimit.description: An active mode whose reinforcement_count reaches this is shown as looping, as is one whose iteration reaches max_iterations. A value of 0 or less uses 5.
